subject: Transportation Engineering I
chapters: Chapter 1: Transportation System, Planning and Engineering

questions.text: Explain Modes of Transportation and their characteristics. Explain Road Classification in Nepal according to Nepal Road Standard (NRS): National Highways, Feeder Roads, District Roads, and Urban Roads.

Explain Highway Alignment: Factors controlling highway alignment (Obligatory points, Traffic, Geometric design, Economy). Explain Engineering Surveys for highway location: Map Study, Reconnaissance, Preliminary Survey, and Final Location & Detailed Survey.

Explain Geometric Design of Highways: Cross-sectional elements (Right of way, Carriage way, Camber, Shoulder, Kerb). Derive expression for Stopping Sight Distance ($SSD = v t + \frac{v^2}{2 g f}$) and Overtaking Sight Distance (OSD).

Derive formula for Super-elevation on horizontal curves: $e + f = \frac{v^2}{g R}$. Calculate design super-elevation and length of transition curve (Clothoid spiral) based on rate of change of centrifugal acceleration ($C$). Explain Extra-widening on horizontal curves ($W_e = \frac{n l^2}{2R} + \frac{V}{9.5 \sqrt{R}}$).

Explain Vertical Alignment: Gradients (Ruling, Limiting, Exceptional), Grade Compensation on horizontal curves, Summit Curves, and Valley Curves with design for head-light sight distance and comfort criteria.

Explain Highway Materials: Subgrade Soil (California Bearing Ratio - CBR test), Road Aggregates (Los Angeles Abrasion test, Aggregate Impact test, Flakiness Index), and Bituminous Binders (Penetration, Ductility, Softening Point, Flash and Fire point tests).
